variableContract.person: identity/clothes may vary, but one recognizable centered guide stays around x26–75%, y21–100% with face near x53%, y32%
variableContract.text: content may vary while role, one-line silhouette, size ratio, semantic two-color split and low-weight source stay
variableContract.product: item, clothing or tool may vary as a natural part of person or truthful scene, without floating product collage
variableContract.color: exact colors may vary; dark real photo, middle-light translucent neutral strips, pale headline pair and localized garment color keep their luminance and area order

invariantContract.layout: upper strip x0–100%, y5–25%; hero x1–63%, y8–23%; person x26–75%, y21–100%; right strip x59–100%, y30–43%; support x63–98%, y33–39%; source x38–63%, y92–95%
invariantContract.visualMass: real scene visible about 70–80%; person garment visible about 20–28%; overlaid band footprint about 25–30%; lettering actual ink about 7–10%; overlaps are not additive
invariantContract.specialEffects: two translucent strips with scene penetration, short soft lettering shadow, same-photo hair and shoulder foreground overlap
